config.mcp.locked_notice: MCP is locked in the Danger Zone
config.mcp.locked_desc: Enable "MCP Server Connections" in the Danger Zone first before configuring MCP servers.
config.mcp.disabled_desc: Enable the toggle above to connect MCP servers.
config.mcp.name_exists: A server with this name already exists.
config.mcp.field_environment_secret_hint: Store passwords and tokens as MCP secrets and reference them here with {{alias}} instead of plaintext.
config.mcp.field_allowed_tools_hint: Optional tool limit. Leave empty to allow all discovered tools; enter tool names to restrict execution and routing to only those tools.
config.mcp.routing_desc: Choose which connected MCP tool AuraGo should use for built-in web search and image analysis.
config.mcp.routing_empty: No MCP routing targets are available yet. Add and enable an MCP server first.
config.mcp.mapping_web_search_desc: Uses the selected MCP tool instead of AuraGo's standard web search backend.
config.mcp.mapping_vision_desc: Uses the selected MCP tool instead of the configured Vision provider for analyze_image.
config.mcp.mapping_no_tools: No runtime tools found for this server
config.mcp.mapping_tool_selected: AuraGo now uses this tool for {capability}.
config.mcp.server_desc: Configure how external MCP servers are started and where they can read or write files.
config.mcp.secrets_desc: Store API keys and other secrets in the vault and reference them in env vars with {{alias}}.
config.mcp.field_allow_local_fallback: Allow local fallback if Docker start fails
config.mcp.secret_value_placeholder_set: Leave empty to keep current vault value
config.mcp.secret_value_placeholder_empt: Enter the value to store in the vault
config.mcp.headers_hint: Use one header per line. Vault aliases such as {{remote-token}} are resolved at runtime and scrubbed from logs.
config.mcp.name_command_or_url_required: Name plus command or URL are required.
config.mcp.field_allow_private_network: Allow private addresses for this MCP server
config.mcp.load_failed_disabled: Adding, editing and deleting is disabled until the list has loaded.
config.mcp.mapping_server_help: MCP server whose tool takes over this capability. Without a selection the agent uses the built-in function.
config.mcp.mapping_tool_help: Tool of the selected MCP server that is called instead of the built-in function.
config.mcp.field_name_help: Unique name of the server; the agent sees its tools under this name.
config.mcp.field_transport_help: How AuraGo reaches the server: stdio starts a local program, the other types connect to an address.
config.mcp.field_command_help: Program that starts the server, such as npx or uvx.
config.mcp.field_url_help: Address of the MCP server, such as https://example.com/mcp.
config.mcp.field_runtime_help: Local starts the program directly on the server, Docker wraps it in a container.
config.mcp.field_args_help: Arguments for the program, one per line.
config.mcp.field_docker_image_help: Docker image the server runs in. Only needed for the Docker runtime.
config.mcp.field_docker_command_help: Command executed in the container, such as uvx.
config.mcp.field_host_workdir_help: Folder on the server that is mounted into the container so files persist.
config.mcp.field_container_workdir_help: Working folder in the container the host folder is mounted to (default /workspace).
config.mcp.enabled_checkbox_help: Only enabled servers are connected and provide tools to the agent.
config.mcp.field_allow_local_fallback_he: Starts the program directly on the server if starting Docker fails. Warning: it then runs without container isolation.
config.mcp.field_allow_private_network_h: Lets this server connect to addresses on the private network, such as 192.168.x.x. Warning: it can then reach devices in your home network. Enable only for servers you trust.
config.mcp.field_allow_destructive_help: Warning: the agent may also call tools of this server that can delete or modify data. Enable only if you trust the server.
config.mcp.secret_alias_help: Short name used to insert the secret as {{alias}} in headers and environment variables.
config.mcp.secret_label_help: Display name to tell secrets apart in this list.
config.mcp.secret_description_help: Short note on what the secret is used for.
config.mcp.secret_value_help: The secret value, such as an API token. It is stored encrypted in the vault and not shown again.
config.mcp.secret_clear_value_help: Deletes the stored value on save.
